rationale: Both role-isolated advisory inputs were present from distinct runs and model families, pinned to the same frozen candidate. The academic review returned request-changes with six major and three minor findings; the learning-design review approved with four notes. No finding carries blocking severity and every one was correctable in this pass, so all were disposed here. Three mattered most. A comparison the lesson used to justify trusting its inputs was not independent of them, because the quoted fold-difference is itself derived from pH values; it is now a consistency check on the arithmetic and nothing more. A claim that bacteria pay none of the costs of compartmentalisation and buy none of its benefits was simply false, and is narrowed to the eukaryotic endomembrane system with bacterial energetics, transport, localisation and known compartment exceptions preserved. And the clinical wrap-up attributed the presentation to lost absorptive surface when the review it rests on says that does not fully account for it; the scene now distinguishes the apical route that fails from the secretory routes that do not, which is a better fit for a lesson about delivery. The academic verdict stands as dissent and no reviewer has seen the repaired text.
dissent: The academic review's request-changes verdict stands as material dissent from the candidate as reviewed. Its findings were incorporated by the maintainer afterwards; no reviewer has approved the repaired text.
conditions: The repaired content is committed first and that commit is stamped as finalCommit, with no teaching-content change afterward.
